items.address_en: About 250 m north of Joypurhat Railway Station
items.notes: Seen only as a 'tea shop' in Mapcarta's nearby-places lists (from OpenStreetMap) on the Joypurhat Railway Station and Mr Tatka pages; it has no page of its own, so no coordinates were given. Undated.

Single aggregator (restaurantsbd.one, page modified 31 Mar 2026), which lists it among Joypurhat restaurants with rating 4.3, hours 10:00-22:30 daily and this phone. The address is taken from the listed business name ('লোকান্ত ৫৯০০ পারুলিয়া পাঁচবিবি রোড জয়পুরহাট'). The upazila comes from the 5900 (Joypurhat Sadar) postcode in that name; please verify. The round-2 run skipped it because the type was unclear, and no other source confirms what kind of eatery it is.

items.address_en: Khanjanpur, about 110 m north-west of Joypurhat Technical School and College and 160 m east of Khanjanpur Bazar
items.notes: Only source is an OpenStreetMap node (tourism=hostel, node 10688080981) shown on Mapcarta, spelled 'Khanjonpur Misson Boys Hostel'. Undated; the node ID range suggests it was mapped around 2023. Gender is from the name ('Boys'). Presumably linked to the Khanjanpur Catholic mission, but no source says who runs it, who can stay or what it costs. An AsiaNews article (2018) on the Khonjanpur parish mentions a parish school but no hostel.

searched_but_not_found: MESS/HOSTEL (Cybo pages 2-5): Cybo's Bangla hostel list still shows 116 results with only 25 on page 1, and the page has no pagination links. ?p= is allowed by Cybo's robots.txt, but every URL tried failed with CLIENT_ERROR: ?p=2 and /?p=2 (Bangla), /2/, the trailing-slash variant, the English www.cybo.com and yellowpages.cybo.com hostel pages, the Joypurhat root pages, hotels-and-motels, panchbibi pages, postal-code 5910/5940 pages and BD-biz pages. Only URLs fetched in round 2 still loaded, which suggests Cybo now blocks new fetches. About 91 named messes on Cybo are still not captured. Web search does not index Cybo's Joypurhat hostel BD-biz pages either.

MESS/HOSTEL (other): OpenStreetMap via Mapcarta has only 4 hostel nodes in the college/station area (Sifat, Ananya, Jim Mess, Govt College Girls Hostel, all already in the app) plus Khanjanpur Mission Boys Hostel. Also searched: news sites (Prothom Alo, Jagonews, Jugantor, Kaler Kantho, Samakal and others) for Joypurhat chhatrabas, chhatrinibas and mess names; thetolet.com and toletbd.app (seat/room ads name no mess); placedigger (0 Joypurhat residence or restaurant results); bn/en Wikipedia for Joypurhat Govt College and Girls' Cadet College (no hostel names; the Govt Women's College bn page does not exist). Found no named hostels for the Polytechnic, Technical School & College, PTI, Women's College, or any upazila college or school.

SKIPPED (mess): the 'Joypurhat Stadium Building' OSM way (W1149610472) is tagged tourism=hostel but has no other information, so it is unclear whether it is a hostel. Cybo's 'কফি শপ' (listed under hostels, 'বেজখন্ড শফিউল ভিলা, মাত্রাই 5930') was also skipped: the name is generic, the address is a private villa, and it is not clearly a business.

RESTAURANTS in Panchbibi, Kalai, Khetlal: none found. OSM via Mapcarta has no eateries near the Panchbibi Upazila Health Complex, Panchbibi town or Akkelpur bus stand/old bazar. Trip.com's 'Panchbibi' and 'Khetlal' restaurant pages are generic Bangladesh lists (the Joypurhat entries are already in the app). Recent headlines on the Prothom Alo topic pages (Akkelpur, Panchbibi, Kalai, Khetlal), the Jagonews upazila pages (Akkelpur, Kalai, Khetlal, Panchbibi, Sadar), the Kalbela pages (district, Kalai, Khetlal, Panchbibi) and RisingBD's Joypurhat page name no other eatery. A Naya Diganta report of a consumer-rights drive at Panchbibi bazar (9 Sep, year not stated) does not name the 3 shops it fined. Vromonguide and touristplaces.com.bd spot pages list only Sadar restaurants that are already in the app.

PARLOURS in Akkelpur, Kalai, Khetlal, Panchbibi: none found in any source (Cybo upazila pages blocked; OSM/Mapcarta has no hairdresser or beauty nodes there; news searches found nothing; placedigger has nothing).
MENUS: no source with dated dish prices was found for any new place.

POSSIBLE DUPLICATE skipped: 'New Sherma Hotel & Resturant' (OSM node 5158335898, 7MQF423G+78) sits about 30 m from restaurantsbd.one's 'শর্মা সুইটস (মীনা)' hotel (423G+69W, Sugar Mill Road). It is very likely the existing Mina Restaurant / Sharma Sweets (Meena), so no new record was made.

CHECK EXISTING (Biler Ghaat): food.json places 'Biler Ghaat' (Trip.com, plus code 23P9+J25, about 25.036N 89.068E) in Joypurhat Sadar. A Jagonews report (21 Jul 2025, https://www.jagonews24.com/country/news/1038066) puts 'বিলের ঘাট' on the Tulshiganga in Khetlal upazila, where a tourist spot 'নিঃশব্দ' opened. If the eatery and this ghat are the same place, the upazila may be Khetlal; not confirmed.

CHECK EXISTING (Moyna Bahar Hotel): places.json lists it under residential hotels, but OSM tags it amenity=restaurant at 25.10209, 89.02596 (7MQF422G+R9, https://mapcarta.com/N5158339530), near Hotel Swad and Khawa Dawa.

SEARCH LIMITS: the WebSearch tool barely indexes Bangla local news or directory pages for these upazilas. Site-restricted Bangla searches on national news domains worked better but rarely named eateries.
